In the context of hyperbolic groups acting on hyperbolic spaces, this often implies that the group is not convex cocompact. For a general proper action, geometric finiteness is often characterized by the existence of a finite-sided fundamental polyhedron or similar compactness properties. A crucial distinction in the theory of Kleinian groups and hyperbolic groups is that geometrically finite groups have "tame" dynamics at infinity, while geometrically infinite groups do not.
